legal_ref: Value Added Tax Act 1998 s.10(1) and Fourth Schedule, as amended by Finance Act 20/2002
quote: Fourth Schedule (section 10): "Rate of VAT ... 15 per cent"; endnote 466: "FA 20/2002 – FOURTH SCHEDULE amended w.e.f 01.07.02" (previously 12 per cent from 01.07.01, 10 per cent under VAT Act 1998). MRA guide: "The standard rate of VAT is 15%."
source_title: Value Added Tax Act (Consolidated Version up to May 2026), Mauritius Revenue Authority; also MRA 'Guide on Simplified VAT Registration' Sept 2025 (mra.mu/download/GuideVATReg.pdf)
notes: Single standard rate 15%; zero-rated supplies (0%) in Fifth Schedule (incl. exports); exempt supplies in First Schedule. Compulsory registration threshold (Sixth Schedule): annual turnover of taxable supplies Rs 3 million from 1 October 2025 (reduced from Rs 6 million by Finance Act 2025).
